prs.title: refactor(tally): rename --top to --limit
prs.head: feat/limit-flag
prs.author: dev
prs.body:
## Why
`--limit` matches what our other tools call a row cap, so one name works everywhere.

## What changed
- `--top` is now `--limit`, with the same default of 5.
- The CLI test uses the new name.

## Scope
- A rename only; counting and output format are untouched.

## Blast Radius
Scripts that pass `--top` must switch to `--limit`.

## Verification
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`
